name: Uldaman
summary: In Uldaman, rival excavators and troggs now clash within the sealed halls. Beneath the northern Badlands mountains, this ancient titan vault holds the buried origins of the dwarven race, with stone sentinels still on guard.

sections.title: The Vault of the First Creations
sections.body:
Titan watchers built Uldaman beneath the earth as a refuge and a place of research. Their first attempts to shape living stone made the misshapen troggs. They sealed them in stasis chambers, then tried again and created the stone-skinned earthen.

The deepest halls hold vital records, including the fabled Discs of Norgannon. Stonekeeper Archaedas and the giantess Ironaya guarded the vault. Dwarven legend says the earthen gave rise to the dwarven race, whose cradle lay buried and forgotten beneath the hills.

sections.title: Excavation and Turmoil
sections.body:
Ironforge prospectors broke through Uldaman’s outer gates, and their pickaxes cracked open the stasis chambers. Awakened troggs flooded the upper tunnels, drove back the dwarven teams, and cut off the early dig sites. Dark Iron dwarves also marched into the ruins, seeking artifacts of supreme power for their fiery master, Ragnaros.

Now rival dig teams, bloodthirsty troggs, and titan constructs battle in the deep shafts. The constructs awaken to smash any trespasser, whatever their clan or cause.

faq.answer: Along the northern edge of the Badlands, Uldaman holds a vast underground titan facility built at the dawn of the world. The titans sealed failed experiments there and kept historical records, including the Discs of Norgannon.

faq.q: Why is Uldaman important to the dwarves?
aliases: why do dwarves care about uldaman
faq.answer: Dwarven legends say their ancestors, the stone-skinned earthen, were created in titan facilities like Uldaman. The Discs of Norgannon lie buried at the heart of the ruins, and decoding them could reveal the truth of dwarven origins.

faq.q: Why are troggs infesting the ruins?
faq.answer: The troggs were the titans’ first attempt to shape stone servants. When the experiment failed, the titans sealed them in Uldaman’s stasis vaults. Ironforge miners accidentally broke into those chambers, freeing the troggs to spread through the corridors and surrounding mountains.

faq.q: What are the Dark Iron dwarves doing here?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves search Uldaman for ancient titan artifacts. They hope to find powerful relics like the Discs of Norgannon for their elemental master, the Firelord Ragnaros.

aliases: who is the boss of uldaman
faq.answer: Archaedas, a massive stonekeeper, guards Uldaman’s lowest vault. He was charged with protecting the complex and its knowledge, alongside living stone constructs and golems.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Uldaman touches the roots of your heritage. For generations, the Ironforge clans wondered where they came from. Dwarven legends point to stone discs buried beneath these trogg-infested halls.
Uldaman’s titan-worked halls hold rich veins of rare earth and metals untouched for millennia. Reaching them means braving trogg ambushes and awakened stone sentinels.
